slides.title: Why strawberries?
slides.body:
Wild strawberries grow in small patches in the forest. When you find a good one, you come back every summer, and you don't tell everyone.

A *smultronställe* can be a café, a beach, a bench or a bookshop.

slides.sv: Den här lilla stranden är mitt *smultronställe*.
slides.en: This little beach is my favourite place.

caption:
Smultronställe: a wild strawberry spot. It means a small, special place that you love, and maybe keep a little secret.

Ingmar Bergman's 1957 film Smultronstället is known in English as Wild Strawberries.

Where is your smultronställe?
